correctness.rationale: The general count partitions r-tuples by 3D and 2D vector-space span; the only 2D non-generating spans are the q+1 Lie-subalgebra planes. For q odd, the bracket exterior-square map is invertible; projective conic counts q+1 planes, the Lie algebra is simple and perfect, Aut=PGL2(q) has order q(q²−1), and Goursat gives pairwise distinct free Aut orbits across factors. For q even, sl2 is 3D Heisenberg and the direct-power quotient spans iff the Lie subalgebra does; the quotient full-row-rank count times independent central lifts gives the formula. Exact finite-field closure enumerations for q=2,3,4,5, odd orbit counts q=3,5 and even quotient-rank counts q=2,4 passed with VERIFY_OK. Finite checks supplement, not replace, arbitrary-rank proof.

value.rationale: Counting all ordered generating tuples for arbitrary numbers of direct factors is a natural Lie-theoretic enumeration distinct from existence. The formulas resolve exact generation capacity and exhibit a sharp field-characteristic transition: fixed two generators generate q²(q−1) factors for odd q but only one for even q, despite identical single-factor counts. The construction is a full natural-family classification in q,k,r and not an unmotivated bounded table; standard Goursat/plane-count tools are appropriately credited.
